title: 英文程度小考（單字＋文法）

questions.q: I drink a glass of ____ every morning.
questions.explain: water（水）：喝的東西。

questions.q: She is my mother's sister, so she is my ____.
questions.explain: aunt（阿姨／姑姑）：媽媽的姊妹。

questions.q: It is very cold today. Please wear a warm ____.
questions.explain: coat（外套）：冷的時候穿。

questions.q: She ____ a student.
questions.explain: 主詞 she 搭配 is。

questions.q: There ____ two books on the table.
questions.explain: two books 是複數，用 there are。

questions.q: I ____ breakfast at seven every day.
questions.explain: 主詞 I 的現在簡單式用 have。

questions.q: I need to ____ my homework before I can watch TV.
questions.explain: finish（完成）搭配 homework。

questions.q: The weather forecast says it will ____ tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
questions.explain: rain 當動詞是「下雨」。

questions.q: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach during our ____.
questions.explain: vacation（假期）：住飯店、去海邊的情境。

questions.q: Could you ____ me your pen for a minute?
questions.explain: lend A B 是「借給 A」；borrow 是「跟別人借」，所以這裡要用 lend。

questions.q: I ____ TV when you called me.
questions.explain: 過去某一刻正在進行的動作：過去進行式 was watching。

questions.q: This bag is ____ than that one.
questions.explain: heavy 的比較級是 heavier。

questions.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ____ at home.
questions.explain: if + 現在式，主要子句用 will。

questions.q: I have lived here ____ 2015.
questions.explain: since 後面接一個起點時間（2015）；for 後面接一段時間。

questions.q: The company decided to ____ the meeting until next week because the manager was sick.
questions.explain: postpone（延後）。

questions.q: He was ____ to find out that he had won the competition.
questions.explain: thrilled（非常興奮）。

questions.q: It is important to ____ a healthy balance between work and personal life.
questions.explain: maintain a balance（維持平衡）是常見搭配。

questions.q: The new phone has many useful ____, such as a better camera and longer battery life.
questions.explain: features（功能、特色）。

questions.q: I'm not sure about the price, so I'll ____ the two shops before I decide.
questions.explain: compare（比較）。

questions.q: If I ____ more time, I would learn another language.
questions.explain: 與現在事實相反的假設：if + 過去式，主要子句用 would。

questions.q: The letter ____ yesterday.
questions.explain: 信「被寄出」，過去式被動 was sent。

questions.q: I wonder where ____.
questions.explain: 間接問句用肯定句語序：where she has gone。

questions.q: I'm not used to ____ up so early.
questions.explain: be used to 後面接動名詞（V-ing）。

questions.q: He suggested ____ a taxi.
questions.explain: suggest 後面接 V-ing（或 that 子句），不接 to V。

questions.q: Planting trees can help ____ the effects of climate change.
questions.explain: mitigate（減輕）。

questions.q: After years of hard work, she finally ____ her dream of becoming a doctor.
questions.explain: fulfill a dream（實現夢想）。

questions.q: His explanation was so ____ that nobody could understand what he meant.
questions.explain: vague（含糊不清的）。

questions.q: The two companies decided to ____ their resources to develop the product faster.
questions.explain: pool resources（集中資源）。

questions.q: The report highlights a ____ gap between rich and poor families.
questions.explain: significant gap（明顯的差距）。

questions.q: By the time we arrived, the film ____.
questions.explain: 到達之前就已經開始：過去完成式 had started。

questions.q: I wish I ____ harder when I was at school.
questions.explain: 對過去的遺憾：wish + 過去完成式。

questions.q: Not only ____ late, but he also forgot the documents.
questions.explain: Not only 放句首要倒裝：did he arrive。

questions.q: The project, ____ was led by Maria, finished early.
questions.explain: 先行詞是事物（project），用 which。

questions.q: You ____ have told me earlier! Now it's too late.
questions.explain: should have + 過去分詞：早該做卻沒做。

questions.q: The politician's ____ remarks offended many voters.
questions.explain: derogatory（貶損的）。

questions.q: The scientist's findings were ____ by further experiments.
questions.explain: corroborate（證實、佐證）。

questions.q: She has a ____ for languages; she picks them up effortlessly.
questions.explain: have a knack for（對…很有天分）。

questions.q: Had I known about the delay, I ____ a different flight.
questions.explain: 省略 if 的過去完成式假設：Had I known…，主要子句 would have + 過去分詞。

questions.q: It is essential that every student ____ the form by Friday.
questions.explain: essential that + 原形動詞（假設語氣）。

questions.q: Hardly ____ the room when the phone rang.
questions.explain: Hardly 放句首要倒裝，且搭配過去完成式：had she entered。
